title: Custom-built machine given for installation work
expect: Supply of goods; Rule 27(d) with Rule 30 - value Rs 2,20,000 (110% of the Rs 2,00,000 cost)
description: A company gives a custom-built machine (cost of manufacture Rs 2,00,000; no market price, no similar sale) to a contractor, who installs a production line for it in return. No money is paid.
